settings.label: Page size parameter

settings.label: Pages at most

settings.label: File name pattern
settings.notice: * and ? as in a file browser, several patterns separated by commas. Empty = every file.

settings.label: When a file fails

settings.label: Move processed files to
settings.notice: Subfolder of the source folder, used when "Source file after a successful run" is "Move". Empty = "processed".

settings.label: File name
settings.notice: Placeholders: {entity}, {profile}, {date}, {time}, {datetime}, {run}, {ext}. Empty = {entity}-{datetime}.{ext}

settings.label: Save as a Google Sheet
settings.notice: The file becomes a Google Sheet; the next export replaces its content and keeps its link.

settings.label: Send to
settings.notice: Comma-separated e-mail addresses.

settings.label: Subject
settings.notice: Empty = "OpenImport export: (profile name)".

settings.label: First row holds the column names
Sheet (Excel, OpenDocument)
settings.notice: Name or position; empty = first sheet.

settings.label: Record path (JSON, XML)
settings.notice: JSON: data.items · XML: /catalog/product or //product. Empty = detect.

settings.label: Root element / key
settings.notice: XML: the root element (default "export"). JSON: wrap the rows in an object under this key (default: a plain array).

settings.label: Record element
settings.notice: Default "item".

settings.label: XSLT before reading (XML)
settings.notice: An XSLT 1.0 stylesheet that turns the file into the XML OpenImport reads (one element per record). No document(), include or import; the file must fit in memory. Empty = none.

settings.label: XSLT after writing (XML)
settings.notice: An XSLT 1.0 stylesheet applied to the written XML (root and record names as set above) before it is delivered: any layout a partner wants. Empty = none.

settings.label: Archives (ZIP, gzip, tar)
settings.notice: A .zip, .gz, .tar or .tar.gz file is unpacked and the file inside is read. Archives inside archives are not unpacked.

option.item: Read the file as it is

settings.label: File inside the archive
settings.notice: Name or pattern such as products-*.csv or data/*.xml. Empty = the first CSV, Excel, ODS, JSON or XML file by name.

settings.label: Compress
settings.notice: The export file is packed before it is delivered; its name gets the archive's extension.

option.item: Only orders not exported before by this profile
New orders and orders changed since their export

settings.label: Statuses
settings.notice: None chosen = every status. Hold Ctrl or ⌘ to choose several.

settings.label: Created from
settings.notice: A day in the time zone of Stores › Configuration › General › Locale. Empty = no limit.

settings.label: Created until
settings.notice: This day counts in full, in the time zone of Stores › Configuration › General › Locale. Empty = no limit.

settings.label: Behaviour
settings.notice: Replace and Delete above the safety limit wait for a typed confirmation.

settings.label: Quantities in the file
settings.notice: Changes add to the current quantity: +5 for a delivery, -3 for sales elsewhere, a plain 4 adds 4. Cannot be combined with "Skip unchanged rows".

settings.label: URL keys from a pattern
settings.notice: For example {name}-{sku}: Magento fields in braces. Used for rows whose URL key is empty; empty = Magento makes the key from the name.

settings.label: Redirect old URLs (301)
settings.notice: When a URL key changes, the old address answers with a permanent redirect to the new one, so links and search results keep working.

settings.label: Order numbers
settings.notice: Keep: the file's numbers are the shop's order numbers (an order that exists is skipped). Generate: every order gets the next number of its store; the file's number only groups the rows.

settings.label: Create invoices, shipments and credit memos
settings.notice: From the invoiced, shipped and refunded quantities of the items, through Magento's own services (offline, nothing is charged, no e-mails). The state and status of the file are kept.

settings.label: Reduce stock
settings.notice: Subtract the ordered quantities from the products' stock, as a new order would. Off: historic orders leave the stock alone.

settings.label: Errors allowed
settings.notice: How many rows may have errors before nothing is imported. With "Stop" the other rows are imported up to this number; with "Skip" it only matters when no row is left. 0 = no errors allowed.

settings.label: Pictures that cannot be read
settings.notice: Pictures given as web addresses are downloaded and kept, so later runs only ask whether they changed. Pictures given as file names are read from var/import/images.

option.name: error
option.item: Report the row as an error

option.name: skip
option.item: Import the row without the picture

settings.label: Build configurable products
settings.notice: Rows with the same "Parent SKU (configurable products)" in step 4 become the variants of one configurable product, which OpenImport creates or updates. A row with product type "configurable" and no parent SKU is that parent's own row.

settings.label: Variation attributes
settings.notice: The attributes the variants differ in (dropdowns with global scope). Map each of them in step 4. Hold Ctrl or ⌘ to choose several.

settings.label: Products missing from the file
settings.notice: For a file that is the complete list: products in the scope below that the file does not name are changed after the import. A run with row errors changes nothing; the safety limit applies.

settings.label: Attribute code
settings.notice: For example supplier or manufacturer.

settings.label: Value
settings.notice: The option label for dropdowns, e.g. the supplier's name.

settings.label: Skip unchanged rows
settings.notice: Rows that are exactly what the last successful run sent are skipped. Changes made in the admin since then are not noticed; run with "full" now and then if you edit records by hand.

settings.label: Safety limit
settings.notice: Empty = the limit in Stores › Configuration › iranimij › OpenImport.

option.name: include
option.item: Import only the rows that match

option.name: include_export
option.item: Export only the records that match

option.name: exclude_export
option.item: Leave out the records that match

settings.label: Schedule
settings.notice: Times are in the time zone of Stores › Configuration › General › Locale.

settings.label: Time
settings.notice: Hours and minutes, for example 05:30.

settings.label: Cron expression
settings.notice: minute hour day month weekday, for example 30 5 * * 1-6

settings.label: Also run when
settings.notice: Starts a live run within a minute after the event, while automatic runs are on. Many events in a minute make one run; what OpenImport's own runs write starts nothing (use "Then run" for that). Hold Ctrl or ⌘ to choose several.

settings.label: To the statuses
settings.notice: "An order changes status" runs only for these new statuses. None chosen = every change.

settings.label: Automatic runs are on
settings.notice: The schedule and the triggers start runs only while this is on. New profiles start off: switch it on after a dry run you are happy with.

settings.label: Send to
settings.notice: Comma-separated. Empty = the admin who created the profile.

settings.label: Then run
settings.notice: Job chain: the profile that runs after this one (as a live run, with this run as its parent). Not after dry runs. A profile cannot run again in the same chain.
